title: Entangled Tank
subtitle: LV, 8 FE/t, 16 shared buckets
text:
Every Entangled Tank on the same code shares one tank of 16 buckets of one fluid.

Any fluid pipe works on a public tank. A private tank only connects to Simple Machines pipes and cables you placed yourself; other mods' pipes only work on public devices. Pipes placed before 2.2 have no owner, so replace them.

Put a bucket of fluid in the top slot to pour it in, or an empty one to fill it.

It uses 8 FE/t and holds 20k FE, and stops sharing without power. The code and fluid survive breaking it.
caption: Two tanks, one fluid
